Last year the bakery recorded revenue of $480,000 and retained profit of $85,000, which is held in its reserves for future growth. The shops currently pay $9,600 a year to hire two small vans for deliveries.

The owners want to buy a refrigerated delivery van for $60,000 to supply three nearby supermarkets with fresh bread and cakes each morning. Two new wholesale contracts begin in March. They are weighing up using retained profit for the van against a 4 year bank loan at 6.5% annual interest, with monthly repayments of $1,400 over 48 months. Repaying the loan would cost $67,200 in total, and the owners are worried about cash flow during quiet winter weeks when sales dip.
